pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
The Forest Doll slows nearby hostile mobs and provides the owner with ongoing recovery.

• HP: 120
• Regen IV + Resistance II (no Fire Resistance)

pages.title: Aura & Abilities
pages.text:
Aura
• Slowness: hostile mobs within 16 blocks slow down (Slowness IV, expires naturally when they leave)
• Threat marking: hostile land mobs within 32 blocks are highlighted (spectral-arrow outline)
• Owner recovery: the owner within 16 blocks gains constant Regen I
• Friendly-mob attraction: draws nearby untamed animals closer

Offhand shield
When the doll holds a shield in its offhand, it reflects 100% of incoming damage.

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text:
Surround the center with 8 oak logs to craft the Forest Doll Egg.

Name the egg on an anvil, then right-click the ground while holding it to summon the doll.
